description: Switches a report of type SlideDeck to a template's theme, slide masters, layouts and slide size, as the Templates drawer in the app does. Its slides keep their content and move to the template's matching layouts; the answer names the slides that had no match, and the version saved just before as versionBeforeId: restore it with restoreReportVersion to undo the change. Only its editors may, and not while the report is running or the slides agent is working on it.

templateId.description: The template, by its `id` from `listTemplates`. Rollstack's own template has the fixed id `rollstack-signature`.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

name: applyReportTemplate
title: Apply template
